WATADEX · Field Guide
What is this?
The WATADEX

The WATADEX is W.A.T.A.'s interactive field guide for clean water and WASH — Water, Sanitation & Hygiene. It turns real water science into a world of creatures, items, and places that anyone can explore and learn from.

Every creature, item, and region in the WATADEX is grounded in real HWTS (Household Water Treatment and Safe Storage) science, verified against CAWST training materials.

W.A.T.A. Mission
Water Access To All — building clean water systems for communities across Vietnam, Myanmar, Thailand, El Salvador, Colombia, and Guatemala.
The World
Watamon

Watamon are creatures that represent real water concepts. There are four types:

Contamination
Real water threats — bacteria, viruses, parasites, sediment
Treatment
Real solutions — boiling, filtration, chlorination, SODIS
Legendary
Spirit creatures that appear when communities solve their water problems
Titan
Ancient forces representing major water source types — rivers, groundwater, rain
The Threat
Contamination

Contamination Watamon represent the real biological and chemical threats found in unsafe water worldwide. They come in eight families:

Real Science
Each contamination creature's stats, habitats, weaknesses, and resistances are based on real documented behavior of that contaminant in water systems. Bacteria are the most common threat in W.A.T.A.'s field regions.
The Response
Treatment

Treatment Watamon represent the real methods W.A.T.A. trains communities to use. Each one is a genuine HWTS technique — from the simplest bucket with a lid to advanced ceramic filtration.

The World
Regions & Towns

The WATAMON world is built around W.A.T.A.'s six real field regions — each region inspired by a real place where W.A.T.A. works.

The Team
W.A.T.A. in the Field

Behind every deployment is a team of Ambassadors, Warriors, Partners, and Volunteers working with local communities on water access, education, and long-term systems.
